verdict.rationale: The New York Department of State is a statutory public-records registry. Filings are by definition held by New York State under its jurisdiction, so a user-selectable storage region or residency option is a cloud/SaaS axis that does not fit this kind of product. The filer-designated county distribution of filing copies (docs-12) is a legal distribution function, not a choice of data storage location, so it does not make the axis applicable.
